title: A different rhythm still values your words

captions.physics: Changing when and how you talk
captions.emotions: Feeling the loss of familiar talks

meaning: As the timing and form of conversation change, you can keep wanting communication to develop while acknowledging sadness for a familiar exchange left behind.
text: Changed circumstances sometimes alter the form of communication rather than its subject. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in revising when and how long you talk. The Empress in energy supports a wish to preserve living space for stories, details and each other’s answers. Death in emotions brings farewell to a familiar conversation. Wanting communication to develop can remain warm while losing the known rhythm still feels real.

For example, a changed schedule no longer leaves room for a long Sunday conversation. You discuss sharing smaller accounts on other days instead of squeezing the whole week into a few minutes. **A new form of communication does not cancel the old one’s value**. Short stories may be lively and detailed, yet you can still miss the old unhurried conversation. You do not have to prove the new option better: it responds to changed conditions and is only beginning to find its own rhythm.

A painful point comes from treating sadness as refusal to sustain communication. Every sigh about the old Sunday then prompts further arguments for shorter exchanges. The Empress’s constructive wish to let conversation grow helps hear this loss too. You can develop a new form without requiring yourselves to love it just as strongly in advance; farewell to an old rhythm does not mean interest in each other has disappeared.
